notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics vendor building in-app search + assistant and reranking for recommendations. Primary goal is to launch pilot with low latency (p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms for lightweight rerank calls) and keep unit cost manageable as usage scales. They started on Hosted API to move quickly; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost for 3rd quarter customers.

POC details: Hosted API POC indexes ~1.2M docs; test workload mixes: 70% low-cost embedding lookups, 20% short-rerank calls (seq len < 256), 10% long-context fetches. Observed hosted cost projections at current traffic: ~12k/mo (demo assumptions) which would scale to ~40k/mo at target usage. They asked for guidance on reducing token cost and preferred Redwood approach: batching at gateway, dynamic KV caching of frequent prefixes, and quantization to int8 for rerank model variants.

Cost optimization workshop notes (03-05):
- Batch sizing: recommended dynamic batching with latency tail controls; we showed a config reducing per-token cost ~18% in synthetic runs (batch window 25ms, adaptive by QPS).
- KV cache: suggested prefix/KV caching for user sessions and personalization cache; early tests show 35-50% token reduction for repeat user flows.
- Quantization/profile: proposed mix of fp16 for long-context + int8-quantized smaller rerank model for bulk rerank traffic; target 20-30% model inference cost reduction while keeping MRR stable.
- Routing policy: route non-sensitive, low-criticality queries to cheaper model variant; keep pii/secure responses pinned to dedicated private pool.
- Unit economics: modeled ARR scenarios (see pricing deck). For target 300k queries/day estimated with optimization: anticipated infra spend drop from ~$40k/mo -> $18-25k/mo depending on cache hit and batching efficiency.

Security/Compliance: need SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, and EU data residency for subset of customer data. Legal will require addendum for residency controls.

Quotes & customer pain: "We can move faster on Hosted but need predictable costs before committing to production." "If we can get ~30% cost savings with no UX regression, Dedicated looks attractive."

Action items:
- Run 2-week micro-POC on Dedicated: 2x A100-equivalent nodes, validate p95 and cost per 1M tokens under peak sim (owner: Diego)
- Implement KV caching stub in POC and report cache hit rates after 5 days (owner: Tomas)
- Share quantized model perf diff report (int8 vs fp16) and recommended profile; quick AB on rerank quality (owner: Redwood Applied ML)
